name: lifequest-grind
description: LifeQuest — gamified activity tracker, second brain and focus dashboard (local-first, free)

scripts.test:all: node scripts/verify-ids.js && node scripts/smoke-test.js && node scripts/smoke-results.js
scripts.verify:exe: node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('electron/main.js','utf8');for (const k of ['screen-saver','open-meet','open-player','setPermissionRequestHandler']) { if(!s.includes(k)) throw new Error('main.js missing '+k); } console.log('exe wiring ok')"
